title: Ha Jylli Ka Rynsan (Within the Circle of the Stage)
description: Ceremonial overture and choral prologue sung before traditional Khasi folk dramas and moral pageants.

khasi: Ha jylli ka rynsan ngi ieng lang,
Ban pynpaw ka akor ki tymmen barim,
Ban pyni ka hok bad ka tip-kur tip-kha,
Ban kyrsiew ia ka mynsiem ka jaitbynriew.
english: Within the circle of the stage we stand together,
To portray the refined manners of the ancient elders,
To manifest righteousness and kinship reverence,
To awaken the soul of the mother race.

cultural_context: Ceremonial overture and choral prologue sung before traditional Khasi folk dramas and moral pageants.
